title: RelBench Regression Task Benchmarks with FK-Join Cardinality Profiles
summary: Demo notebook analyzing RelBench regression task benchmarks with FK-join cardinality profiles. Loads pre-computed data for the rel-f1/driver-position task (30 curated examples across train/val/test folds). Demonstrates: relational schema extraction (9 tables, row counts, PKs/FKs), FK cardinality percentile profiles (3 edge types with min-to-max distributions), task split statistics (7,453 train / 499 val / 760 test rows), mini dataset sizing estimates, and example data parsing. Visualizations include log-scale cardinality profile plots and target distribution histograms by fold.
